scope.domains: Deterministic synthetic finite domains; all joint points enumerated. Coefficients, private choices and GCD labels are illustrative, not real rotation or legal game gear data.
scope.arithmetic: Exact reduced BigInt fractions; no floating-point log, exp or sqrt used as evidence. Imported archive oracle/hull primitives are pure mathematics.
scope.productOracle: Pmax is certified by exhaustive enumeration of this finite domain, not by a new or existing production MIP backend. L/(L-m) only weakens this exact bound; it does not establish a rounded-log error premise.
scope.limits: No production backend, real rotation coefficients, real equipment search, solver speedup, or performance acceptance is implemented or claimed. Hull vertices provide support; interpolated hull points are not physical candidates.
